info.name: The Club API
info.description:
All public REST endpoints of The Club, called through the gateway. See docs/API_TESTING_POSTMAN.md.

Start with **End-to-end journey**: run it with the Collection Runner to exercise the owner and member journeys with assertions. The other folders are a reference, one request per endpoint.

item.name: End-to-end journey

request.description: Public signing keys. Also sets {{runId}} so every run registers fresh accounts.
Fails with code EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED when REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=true: verify first (Auth & account → Mailpit requests).

4. Owner: no owner powers before approval

item.name: 8. Owner: refresh token (picks up CLUB_OWNER role)

request.description: Roles live in the access token, so a new one is needed after approval. Refresh tokens rotate: the old one stops working.

request.description: Allowed once the event has started: returns 409 NOT_STARTED when run right after creating it (start is 2 hours ahead).

item.description: Run in order (Collection Runner). Creates a fresh owner and member each run, takes an owner from sign-up through admin approval to a published event, registers the member for a free and a paid event, checks the ticket in and publishes a recap. Needs PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock and the admin credentials in the environment.

request.description: Clubs you follow or subscribe to, plus nearby clubs (by lat/lng, or by city when there are no coordinates).
Only after the event has started.
Free: CONFIRMED at once. Paid: PENDING_PAYMENT with a checkout (seat held 15 minutes).
Yourself or an admin.
Free or unpaid registrations, before the start. Paid ones are refunded by the owner.
Opens 6 h before the start, closes 12 h after. 409 when already used; 404 for a ticket of another event.
Called by Razorpay. Without a valid X-Razorpay-Signature it returns 400; use Razorpay's dashboard to send test webhooks.
Yourself or an admin.
month=YYYY-MM, default this month.
type: RUN | RIDE | WALK | HIKE | SWIM | WORKOUT | YOGA | OTHER. distance in km, duration in seconds.
Yourself or an admin (403 for anyone else).
404 unless it is yours (or you are an admin).
Open the returned authorizeUrl in a browser. 503 when Strava isn't configured.
Registers STRAVA_WEBHOOK_CALLBACK_URL with Strava; the URL must be reachable from the internet.
Normally reached through the web app's /strava/callback page after the Strava consent screen; not useful to call by hand.
Strava calls this when a subscription is created; echoes hub.challenge when the verify token matches.
Called by Strava. Events for unknown athletes are acknowledged and ignored.
Yourself or an admin.
Called by ZeptoMail; the token is in secrets/zeptomail-webhook-token.
